text: Fixed. In `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py) the flag default was forced to `False` even for required flags: `if is_flag and default_is_missing:` → now `if is_flag and default_is_missing and not self.required:`. A required flag with no default now reports "Missing option '--flag'" instead of silently being False. Full suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Fixed (verified by a subagent). `_make_cached_stream_func` in src/click/_compat.py now returns None when the source stream is None; `echo()` in src/click/utils.py returns early when there is no stream; `pager()`/`ProgressBar` in src/click/_termui_impl.py fall back to `io.StringIO()`. `click.echo` no longer raises with sys.stdout/sys.stderr set to None; suite still green.

Fixed. `Path.convert` in src/click/types.py resolved symlinks with `os.readlink()` + `os.path.realpath()`, which breaks relative symlinks and symlink chains (the link target was resolved against the CWD, not the link's directory). Now uses `os.fspath(pathlib.Path(rv).resolve())`, so the path is fully resolved as the docstring promises. Verified with relative symlinks, chains and directory symlinks; suite still green.

Fixed. In src/click/decorators.py, `argument()` popped `cls` out of the decorator's shared `attrs` dict, so reusing one `click.argument(..., cls=CustomArgument)` decorator lost the custom class on later uses. `cls` is now an explicit keyword parameter and `ArgumentClass = cls or Argument`, so the class is preserved no matter how often the decorator is reused. Suite still green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Still working on the envvar/flag_value bug in src/click/core.py (a subagent is investigating the parameter-value resolution path). I'll report as soon as it is fixed and verified against the full suite.

Still working on the flag + default_map bug in src/click/core.py. The obvious paths (Option.get_default, Parameter.get_default, Context.lookup_default, consume_value) look correct so far, so I'm narrowing it down further. Will report when fixed and verified.
